plainText:
If you were looking for May's Torchic in Pokémon the Series, see May's Blaziken.
 
 

Haruka's Torchic (Japanese: ハルカ アチャモ Haruka's Achamo) is the main character of Pokémon Chamo-Chamo ☆ Pretty ♪. She has an Adamant nature and doesn't give up until she gets what she wants. 

== History ==
In the beginning of the manga, she and her had just moved to a new town, close to the setting of Magical Pokémon Journey. She quickly meets and becomes friends with and , and then meets , with whom she winds up arguing frequently.

Soon after that, she meets , Poochyena's older brother, who she falls in love with.

In CCP09, she enters a ness and competes against a and a , a duo that regularly competes in Pokémon Contests. She tries to look cute and energetic to impress the judges and the audience, but her moves are not considered cute enough. She ends up in third place with only two votes.

== Personality and characteristics ==
Torchic dreads the thought of ever evolving. She believes that and are ugly and can't stand the thought of not being cute and adorable anymore. She's also afraid that, were she to evolve, Mightyena would be repulsed by her new form. Torchic tends to end her sentences with -chic.
